sens_en: to choose, to carry, to provoke
origine_fr: Une main 扌 et 兆, qui donnait le son mais se lit zhào, loin de tiāo. La main trie, soulève, porte à la palanche. Lu tiāo, c'est choisir et porter ; lu tiǎo, provoquer.
origine_en: A hand 扌 and 兆, which gave the sound but is read zhào, far from tiāo. The hand sorts, lifts, carries on a shoulder pole. Read tiāo, it means to choose and to carry; read tiǎo, to provoke.

phrase.pinyin: Nǐ zìjǐ tiāo yī gè ba.
